Home.welcomeMessage:
Welcome to my portfolio.
This is a space where I share the work I have done and the experience I have gained through software development.
It includes work in application development, system design, and the integration of technology for practical use.

About.title: About Me
About.description1: I started my IT career in System Administration, where I was responsible for managing infrastructure and servers, as well as troubleshooting issues in real-world environments. This experience gave me a strong foundation in understanding how systems operate at a deeper level, including their limitations, stability, and the challenges of working in production environments.
About.description2: Building on that foundation, I transitioned into IoT development, where I worked on MCU-based systems for machine control and data collection, integrating them with databases through APIs. This later evolved into developing web applications for real-time monitoring, visualization, and data analysis. Today, I work as a Fullstack Developer, with Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Go (Golang), and PostgreSQL as my primary technology stack. I have experience designing systems that seamlessly connect infrastructure, IoT systems, and applications to operate efficiently as a whole. With a solid understanding of systems, IoT, and software development, I am able to build solutions that balance business requirements, system stability, and development efficiency.

Skills.title: My Skills
Skills.description: Tools and technologies I use to build web applications, backend services, dashboards, databases, and hardware-integrated solutions.

Projects.title: My Projects
Projects.descriptionOEE:
Developed a web application to display real-time OEE dashboard metrics for IoT systems, including run hours, loss hours, output, and summarized losses. Built interactive dashboards using React (TSX), Chart.js, Material UI, and Redux.
Implemented a Node.js backend and established a connection to a MySQL server. Leveraged stored procedures in MySQL to optimize complex data queries for OEE metrics.
Projects.descriptionMonitorMachine: Developed a full-stack web application for updating machine data and tracking real-time machine status, integrating IoT monitoring using Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, Next.js, NextAuth, and NextUI on the frontend, with a Node.js backend connected to a MySQL server. The system allows authorized users to sign in and modify machine states or related data, while admins can manage user accounts—including creating, editing, deleting, assigning permissions, and resetting passwords—through a centralized user table. Regular users are granted access to update machine information according to their roles and permissions.
Projects.descriptionESD: Developed an Anti-Static ESD Access Control Tester system designed to work with legacy hardware, using a microcontroller to monitor employee status, control door access, and store logs in a MySQL database. The frontend was built with Next.js, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, and NextAuth, while the backend was developed with Node.js. Raspberry Pi runs a Python script to communicate with the ESD testing apparatus. The system includes a data grid for managing employee data (add, edit, delete, display), and an ESD tester display that prompts users to enter their employee ID, verifies access permissions to the production line, and counts signal points to validate results from the ESD machine before sending responses to the BD system.
Projects.descriptionNextAuth: Developed a web application using Next.js with Tailwind CSS for UI design and NextAuth for authentication. The backend is designed based on Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design principles, with clear separation of responsibilities across domain, service, and infrastructure layers. Prisma is used as the ORM connected to PostgreSQL, with data handled through DTOs, schemas, and mappers to enhance security, flexibility, and long-term maintainability and scalability.
Projects.descriptionSmartOr: Co-developed a web application for operating room scheduling and status management in a hospital setting using Next.js and Material UI (MUI). Designed system layouts in Adobe Illustrator and converted them into reusable React components to support real-time visualization and control of room status.
Projects.descriptionPawcare: Co-developed a web application for managing pet food recipes, featuring nutritional calculation and personalized recipe recommendations based on pet type and specific conditions (e.g., age, weight, or health status). Built the frontend using Next.js and the backend with Node.js.
Projects.descriptionOptSence: Co-developed a web application for collecting and visualizing data from IoT sensors, supporting data transmission via APIs and storage in PostgreSQL. Built a real-time dashboard using Next.js and Node.js, and designed the dashboard UI using Canva, which was later implemented as a functional interface.
Projects.descriptionUniva: Developed a Dashboard UI using Next.js, Chart.js, and Tailwind CSS, along with designing a time-based data model for efficient data storage. Implemented a cache table to store aggregated data at monthly and yearly levels, and utilized Cron Jobs for daily aggregation and insertion into the table. This approach improved query performance and enabled efficient data filtering for future use.
Projects.descriptionScada: An experimental development of a web application that simulates the control system of a fan, valve, and water tank using React and SVG. The system visualizes airflow or water flow interactively based on user input, supports valve toggling, fan speed control, and displays real-time water levels in the tank. The entire simulation was designed in Adobe Illustrator and converted into React components using Next.js for client-side rendering.

workExperience.title: Work Experience
workExperience.descriptionBelton: I began working at Belton Co., Ltd. in 2013 - 2024 as an IT Support specialist, where I was responsible for installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting office and production computer systems, including resolving network issues related to Cisco infrastructure. Over the course of more than a decade, I expanded my skill set and transitioned into web and IoT development. I designed and deployed an internal Wi-Fi network and API domain to support IoT projects, utilized MySQL for calculating Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) while preserving raw machine data, and developed microcontroller solutions using Python and Arduino (C/C++) for real-time equipment control and data collection. I also created internal dashboards and web applications using technologies such as Node.js, Next.js, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, and Chart.js to visualize IoT data and support data-driven decisions in the production environment.
workExperience.descriptionGeno: Developed full-stack web applications using Next.js for the frontend and Node.js for the backend, with PostgreSQL as the primary database. Integrated the system with IoT devices to send and receive data from controllers, and visualized real-time data through dashboards. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver efficient and scalable solutions.
